title: Harsham Palliative Fest
alt: Harsham Palliative Care Festival at GEC Idukki
description: The annual palliative awareness festival at GEC Idukki featuring interactive workshops, street plays, and care kit fundraising.

modal.summary: Harsham is our flagship campus and community festival designed to build empathy and demystify palliative care among university students.
points: Interactive volunteer orientation and patient communication workshops.
Cultural performances and street plays raising awareness across Idukki.
Fundraising care kit stalls to sponsor monthly medicine packages for bedridden patients.

title: Old Age Home Outreach
alt: Student volunteers on an elderly care home visit in Idukki
description: Fortnightly visits to elder care homes in Idukki. Student volunteers provide companion care, listen to life stories, and supply comfort kits.

modal.summary: Our bi-weekly companionship initiative directly addresses the severe emotional isolation experienced by elder home residents.
points: Dedicated one-on-one listening sessions and recreational storytelling.
Distribution of essential comfort toiletries, blankets, and nutrition packs.
Coordination with local medical teams for primary health and vitals checkups.

title: Festive Care Drives
alt: Festive care kit distribution for homebound patients
description: Spreading festive warmth to homebound bedridden patients with customized Onam feast kits, traditional wear, and musical visits.

modal.summary: Festive Care Drives ensure that bedridden patients and their caregivers never feel forgotten during major cultural celebrations.
points: Curated Onam and festive feast kits delivered right to patient doorsteps.
Distribution of comfortable clothing, bedding, and celebratory essentials.
Small musical and cultural gatherings brought into patient living rooms.
